input_files.rule: Repository files, current CLI help, minimal capability summaries, dated references, and synthetic fixtures are evidence inputs. Raw auth, provider, token, environment-value, and complete diagnostic output must not enter reports.

contracts.output contract: Return an outcome, evidence and unknowns, only supported prioritized recommendations, a dependency/risk sequence, verification and rollback, and separate local-file versus persistent/external approval options. No change is a valid outcome.
contracts.rollback boundary: The package is read-only prompt, reference, metadata, fixture, test, and report content. It never mutates Codex or external state; any later implementation has its own authorization and rollback boundary.
